'''Lony Hertz's Force Adept Club''' was a business that was ran by [[Lony Hertz]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It specialized in finding [[Force Adept]]s, to pair them with [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] apprentices and so give them a greater understanding of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] from a non-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] perspective.

Hertz once tried to recruit new Force Adepts during the [[Cularin Trade Show]].
